copy.curiosityHook: Confronted by an atrocious crime, can a detective consumed by his own vices genuinely turn his life around before his spiral swallows him whole?
copy.description: In New York City, a corrupt police detective deep in severe drug and gambling addictions takes on the investigation of a young nun's rape, sparking an unexpected struggle to change his ways and find forgiveness.
copy.vibeSummary: Grim, emotionally heavy, and suspenseful; an uncompromising moral drama best taken with full attention alone.
copy.whyWatch: Abel Ferrara delivers a raw, uncompromising portrait of moral crisis, steering standard procedural grit toward intense personal reckoning and spiritual weight.

allowedMaterial: corrupt New York City police detective
investigation of a young nun's rape
attempt to change his ways and seek forgiveness
excludedMaterial: identity or fate of the attackers
third-act choices or consequences of gambling debts
ending or final fate of the lieutenant
